detail.longDescription: 28 of 89 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks had defects; in 16, the instructions and the verifier disagreed. Fixing them (2.1) raised accuracy over 10 points and moved agents up to three ranks. A longer time limit closed a 20-point harness gap on GPT 5.4. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.08417 A pass rate can't tell a wrong agent from a wrong test. Watching the run can. We built a live browser link to an agent's terminal for that: https:// shell.online # AIAgents # MachineLearning # OpenSource
